description: The acquisition records of a collection's AI Agents stage (ADR-010): every application as the stage's signer recorded it — the operator's signed declaration, the wallet, the ERC-8004 identity and its on-chain check, the quantity, the permission's salt and signer, the time — each hashed and a leaf of a Merkle root the collection's owner commits to the RuthvenAnchor registry on Ethereum. With record_id, one record with its proof and the steps to check it against the chain without trusting RUTHVEN. Records are operator-declared; the root proves a record is the one recorded, not that a statement in it is true. No model is involved.

record_id.description: A recordId (0x… 32 bytes) from the list, for its proof.

name: ruthven_agent_stage_records
